summary: BoopBox, a renamed fork of SLOOP that makes the FM-1 an eight-track live groovebox (six synths and two drum machines by default) with no factory patterns. It uses its own project format, so SLOOP projects do not open in it.
features: 13 engines incl. 6-op FM with DX7 patches, physical models, OberVave
223 sounds, 37 drum kits, four user sample slots
Held-button layers: 27 punch-in effects, note repeat, erase, mutes
64 steps per track with p-locks, micro timing, fills; sections A-D
USB audio, TRS MIDI in, clock, sequencer to MIDI out, USB host
Separate BoopBox Trainer firmware teaches three songs on the device

headings: play it live: hold a button, touch a key
lights for playing in the dark 2.3
the menu: settings of the fm-1
usb audio: record the fm-1 on a computer
